howItWorks.headline: Find it, copy it, ship it.
howItWorks.answer: You see exactly how every component moves before you copy it, so you know what you're shipping.

steps.label: Find the component you need
steps.body: Browse the library by category or search by name. Every component runs live, so you see exactly how it behaves before you commit.

steps.label: Copy it in your format
steps.body: One click copies production-ready code, or pull it straight into your editor over MCP. React with useGSAP, Vue with script setup, or vanilla HTML. Typed, documented, reduced-motion aware.

steps.label: Ship it your way
steps.body: Paste it into Next.js, Nuxt, Astro, wherever modern JS runs. Adjust with data attributes or props. No wrestling with the GSAP lifecycle.

twoWays.headline: Two ways to use it.
twoWays.body: A library of signature components you reach for on every project, and Landmark Kits, deep motion systems you buy once and own.
twoWays.libraryBody: Every named signature component, each one production-grade and documented. Subscribe and use the whole catalog across every project you build. New components ship regularly.
twoWays.kitBody: Ten navigations built as one system, and its own product - not a single component, not part of the Library. Fullscreen menus, drawers, and one that tilts the whole page away in perspective. React, Vue, HTML / CSS / JS.

oneComponent.headline: One component, told properly.
oneComponent.body: Circular Slider, a draggable carousel that rides a giant arc. The kind of thing you would spend a day getting right, built the same way every one of the {count} ships.

reveal.headline: The Reveal Kit.
reveal.body: Thirteen preloader and hero-reveal components, built as one system. Pair any cover with any hero, in WebGL or GSAP. React, Vue, plain JS. One purchase, yours forever.

menu.headline: The Menu Kit.
menu.body: Ten navigations, each one its own component. Fullscreen menus, drawers, and one that tilts the whole page away in perspective. React, Vue, plain JS. One purchase, yours forever.

pricingSection.headline: Simple pricing.
pricingSection.subhead: One afternoon of freelance work covers a year of the whole library. Solo is €29 a month billed quarterly for one developer, and Studio is priced per seat, with every seat after the first costing less. Pay yearly to save. Landmark Kits are a one-time purchase, and there are no lifetime tiers or per-feature add-ons.
